name: Local Pattern
description: Adaptive threshold finds local dark detail under uneven lighting. Its selected area responds to printed patterns, stripes and textures rather than overall exposure.
steps: Try a striped card or patterned fabric under uneven lighting.
Map CC 71, channel 1 to resonance; keep the instrument parameter range conservative.
Change the pattern scale or orientation and inspect the local mask.
Adjust neighborhood radius and capture the useful calibration range.
